description: One verified vendor/tool record. Every factual claim must trace to a source in `sources`. Unverifiable facts use the literal string "unverified", never a guess. Retention claims obey specs/RETENTION-RULE.md: ranges only, statute + section + as-of date, Law 25 never cited as the source of a numerical period.

data_residency.description: Hosting regions / residency options, or the literal "unverified".

law25_relevance.description: Why this tool matters for Quebec Law 25 work. Must never present Law 25 as the source of a numerical retention period (enforced by the validator).

mapping_features.description: Data-mapping-relevant capabilities, each verifiable from a listed source.

pricing_model.description: e.g. "paid; tiers unverified", "free tier + paid plans", "open source (self-hosted)". No invented prices; any stated figure needs a source note mentioning pricing.

range.description: Range only, e.g. "6 to 7 years" or "6 to 7 years after the last business transaction".

verify.description: True when no retention period could be cited to a statute; then claims must be empty and notes must say what to verify.
